selected_evidence.requirement: Containerized web application runs as unprivileged appsvc on port 8080
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, the HTTP process runs as host UID 999, maps only to UID 0 inside its private user namespace, has distinct container namespaces and NSpid 1, listens on port 8080, and returns the expected content through $NODE_IP.

selected_evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the enabled user unit, Linger=yes, an empty Sessions field, active appsvc user manager, and automatically recovered webapp-container.service after reboot.

Healthy pre-restart HTTP and old boot ID 0d49f077-ed5b-479a-b08e-ec4392d89c52 were captured with reboot acknowledgement; node1 returned with changed boot ID 17ce4a5c-5afd-4144-84f4-f81100dd9f90; post-restart proof confirms the user manager, container, listener, and web content recovered.

commands.command: set -eu; command -v busybox || true; dpkg-query -W -f='${Status} ${Version}\n' busybox-static 2>/dev/null || true; getent passwd appsvc || true; test ! -e /home/appsvc && echo HOME_AVAILABLE

set -eu
sudo useradd --system --create-home --home-dir /home/appsvc --shell /usr/sbin/nologin appsvc
sudo install -d -o appsvc -g appsvc -m 0750 /home/appsvc/bin /home/appsvc/container/rootfs/bin /home/appsvc/container/rootfs/www /home/appsvc/.config/systemd/user/default.target.wants
sudo install -o appsvc -g appsvc -m 0755 /bin/busybox /home/appsvc/container/rootfs/bin/busybox
sudo ln -s busybox /home/appsvc/container/rootfs/bin/sh
sudo sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "rootless-container-webapp on node1" > /home/appsvc/container/rootfs/www/index.html'
sudo chown appsvc:appsvc /home/appsvc/container/rootfs/www/index.html
sudo sh -c 'cat > /home/appsvc/bin/start-web-container <<"EOF"
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
ROOT=/home/appsvc/container/rootfs
exec /usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --mount --uts --ipc --pid --fork -- /usr/sbin/chroot "$ROOT" /bin/busybox httpd -f -p 8080 -h /www
EOF'
sudo chown appsvc:appsvc /home/appsvc/bin/start-web-container
sudo chmod 0750 /home/appsvc/bin/start-web-container
sudo sh -c 'cat > /home/appsvc/.config/systemd/user/webapp-container.service <<"EOF"
[Unit]
Description=Rootless namespace container web application
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/home/appsvc/bin/start-web-container
Restart=always
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
EOF'
sudo chown appsvc:appsvc /home/appsvc/.config/systemd/user/webapp-container.service
sudo ln -s ../webapp-container.service /home/appsvc/.config/systemd/user/default.target.wants/webapp-container.service
